InstallStagedPackages.description: This action creates install jobs for all eligible firmware packages in the LocalImageStore collection. Supports @Redfish.OperationApplyTime (Immediate or OnReset).
InstallStagedPackages.longDescription: This action accepts no package list parameter. Install jobs are created for all packages with PackageValidationStatus = Success in the LocalImageStore collection based on the operation apply time. The action supports @Redfish.OperationApplyTime with values Immediate (install now) or OnReset (install on next reboot).

RebootHost.description: Whether to trigger a host reboot after update job creation.
RebootHost.longDescription: When set to true and ApplyTime is Immediate, the host system will be rebooted after all update jobs are created. When ApplyTime is OnReset, this parameter is ignored as the reboot will occur at the next scheduled system reset.
